instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a full stack review booster web application with JWT & Google login, business profile configuration (name, category, keywords, Google review URL), AI review draft generator (20 short natural stories using GPT-4o-mini/GPT-5.4 via Emergent LLM key), full CRUD/reorder/regenerate on drafts, duplicate warning detection, unique public review link at /r/:slug with least-recently-used rotation & hiding recently shown drafts in session, instant clipboard copy & automatic redirect to Google review URL, downloadable QR code poster, and owner dashboard with lifetime usage counter. Ensure responsive mobile-first UI with data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines: Always use data-testid on interactive elements
Never use full transparent backgrounds in headers or dropdowns
Respect mobile-first design with generous spacing
Ensure robust error handling and toast notifications via Sonner
